title: Social Security 2026 COLA Increase Explained Simply
bigPicture: Your Social Security payment will increase in 2026 to help keep up with the cost of living.
whatYouNeedToKnow: The raise is called a cost of living adjustment.
It is based on how much prices have gone up over the past year.
The extra money will be added to your regular monthly check.
commonMistakesToAvoid: Thinking you need to apply for the increase.
Confusing the COLA with other benefits like Medicare.
actionSteps: Check your monthly statement to see the new amount.
Make sure your address is up to date with the Social Security office.
